notablePrerequisites: Grenzo has a power of 2 or greater.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Nissa's Chosen, adding {C}{C}.
Nissa's Chosen is put on the bottom of your library instead of in your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Nissa's Chosen into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.
